answer: Each fake costs its operator 658,000 POA. Rewards flow down the river channel through three checkpoints, and at any checkpoint a peer may whisper a report naming a suspected identity. The atlas registry checks the signature, and a confirmed match diverts the full reward — half burned, half paid to the whispering peer — while the operator pays a 400,000 POA toll from its other identities. Five fakes therefore lose 1,290,000 POA in rewards and pay 2,000,000 POA in tolls.
